title: Fix TypeScript build errors in plugin packages
body:
CI build failing with TypeScript errors in three plugin packages: implicit `any` types and composite project configuration issues preventing workspace dependency imports.

## Changes

- **plugin-chatbot**: Add type annotation to ComponentRegistry callback props
  ```typescript
  ComponentRegistry.register('chatbot', 
    ({ schema, className, ...props }: { schema: ChatbotSchema; className?: string; [key: string]: any }) => {
  ```

- **plugin-charts**: Fix type narrowing with intermediate variable, use `ChartConfig` type
  ```typescript
  const newConfig: ChartConfig = {};
  series.forEach((s: any, idx: number) => {
    newConfig[s.dataKey] = { label: s.dataKey, color: colors[idx % colors.length] };
  });
  config = newConfig;
  ```

- **plugin-dashboard**: Add `DashboardWidgetSchema` type annotation to map callback

- **plugin-dashboard/tsconfig.json**: Remove implicit `rootDir` constraint to allow workspace dependency imports (matches pattern in other plugins)
